name: Ecosystem

phase_0.boundary_condition: The thermodynamic and biogeochemical envelope defining the biome carrying capacity.

VINIT.justification: The uninitialized physical environment before biological colonization.

TANCH.justification: The closed boundary enforcing resource limits and system completion.

AFWD.justification: The forward morphism of energy ascent from abiotic to biotic forms.

AREV.justification: The reverse descent of complex organic matter back to simple inorganic states.

CLINK.justification: The sequential chaining of trophic interactions linking producers to apex predators.

IMSCRIB.justification: The self referential feedback loops maintaining internal ecological balance.

FSPLIT.justification: Incident solar energy branches into absorbed and reflected pathways.

FFUSE.justification: Absorbed and reflected energy reconstitute the total incident solar radiation.

EVALT.justification: The affirmative state of stable population dynamics and resource equilibrium.

EVALF.justification: The negative state of resource depletion and population crash.

ENGAGR.justification: The paradice of pioneer and climax species coexisting in perpetual successional tension.

IFIX.justification: The permanent append only record of biological material in sedimentary rock.

phase_3.void_description: Prebiotic abiotic environment devoid of biological organization or energy capture.
phase_3.true_description: Stable climax community maintaining steady state equilibrium within carrying capacity.
phase_3.false_description: Ecological collapse characterized by trophic cascade failure and extinction.
phase_3.both_description: Successional ecotone holding pioneer growth and climax decay in simultaneous tension.

steps.domain_action: Abiotic substrate initialization establishing the physical environment.
Solar radiation influx driving the initial energy gradient.
Radiative partitioning dividing incident energy into absorbed and reflected components.
Photosynthetic capture representing the absorbed energy pathway.
Primary production converting captured photons into chemical biomass.
Albedo reflection representing the unabsorbed energy pathway.
Thermal dissipation radiating reflected energy back to space.
Radiative balance reconstituting the total incident solar radiation from absorbed and reflected components.
Food web formation chaining primary producers to primary consumers.
Consumption partitioning dividing ingested biomass into assimilated tissue and egested detritus.
Secondary production representing the assimilated tissue pathway.
Trophic transfer moving energy to higher consumer levels.
Detritus formation representing the egested waste pathway.
Microbial decomposition breaking down detritus into inorganic nutrients.
Nutrient mineralization reconstituting the abiotic substrate from decomposed matter.
Homeostatic feedback closing the loop to regulate population densities.
Ecotone holding successional growth and decay in simultaneous paradice.
Sedimentation permanently fixing undecomposed organic matter into the geological record.
Carrying capacity enforcement terminating the growth cycle at resource limits.

phase_5.compiler_frontend: Evolutionary algorithms translating environmental pressures into phenotypic adaptations.
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: Chemical signaling and trophic interactions mediating information flow between organisms.
phase_5.memory_mechanism: Genetic code and epigenetic markers storing historical environmental adaptations.
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: Seasonal cycles and circadian rhythms determining the timing of biological operations.
phase_5.alfs_store: The global biogeochemical reservoirs serving as the canonical bootstrap store for elemental cycles.

phase_6.cycle_cost: Free energy dissipated as heat during metabolic processes.
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: High exergy state with concentrated solar radiation and unreacted abiotic substrates.
phase_6.post_cycle_state: Low exergy state with dispersed thermal energy and recycled inorganic nutrients.
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0: The biome operates as a dissipative structure maintaining steady state entropy export to the surroundings.
